parent.rule: Parent raw role must strictly equal 'SIMULATION' without strip or case normalization.

child.rule: Child raw role must strictly equal 'READ_ONLY' without strip or case normalization.

config_id_matching.rule: rawConfigId must equal original untrimmed descriptor expectedConfigId, and snapshot-supported identity_boundary_trim(configId) must equal the SAME untrimmed descriptor expectedConfigId. Do NOT trim both.

capability_boundary_matching.rule: raw config capabilityBoundary must match factory-cloned/trimmed descriptor expectedCapabilityBoundary case-insensitively BEFORE snapshot; raw config capabilityBoundary is never stripped.

structural_vs_opaque.rule: Separate opaque NONBLANK checks from structural ASCII trim and identity boundary trim. Opaque fields (originId, launchPlanId, operatorPairId, fingerprint, policy) retain supplied Unicode content verbatim without applying structural ASCII non-ASCII whitespace rejection.

descriptor_formatting_preservation.rule: Original descriptor expectedRole and expectedCapabilityBoundary padding and lowercase are preserved verbatim in output bundle.

descriptor_sha256.rule: Descriptor expectedConfigSha256 must be strictly 64 ASCII hex characters without padding or trimming.

executable_sha256.rule: Executable SHA256 must be 64 ASCII hex characters allowing trim.

path_normal_form.rule: Fully-qualified local DOS drive paths only. Explicit slash handling rejecting repeated separators (//, \\, \/, /\), empty interior segments, and ambiguous aliases. Preserves valid drive-root (C:\) and normal segments (spaces, Omega).

required_windows_attributes.rule: Existing root, ancestor, input, output directory, and leaf direct lstat requires usable Windows st_file_attributes integer (bool excluded). Missing, None, or non-integer st_file_attributes fails closed.

direct_ancestry_guard.rule: Direct nofollow lstat ancestry guard checks drive root (C:\) and every actual component with os.lstat without lexists/isdir/isfile error-masking; rejects reparse points (0x400) and symlinks; catches only FileNotFoundError for new output leaf.

read_once_provenance.rule: Common readonce helper captures prior lstat, handle fstat, raw bytes, and SHA-256 for spec and configs; linked into PROVENANCE_MANIFEST.json.

userdata_isolation.rule: workerUserDataDirectory and validatorUserDataDirectory must be distinct when normalized.

content_profile_fingerprint.rule: expectedContentProfileFingerprint must be an opaque non-blank string (not constrained to 64 hex characters).

package_policy_declaration.rule: Object containing schemaVersion, policyId, revision, and admittedPackageIds; revision admits string or integer with explicit boolean exclusion; admittedPackageIds retains order.

timestamp_format.rule: issuedAtUtc must be a valid Gregorian UTC ISO 8601 string validated with full consumption regex _ISO_UTC_REGEX.fullmatch(val) (ASCII digits [0-9], calendar/leap/time validity), preserving exact raw fractional digits (Parent .1234567Z, Child .0000000Z).

cli_invocation.rule: Strict --spec <absoluteSpecPath> CLI invocation with exact argc 3; closed 6 required keys + optional bundleFilename fixed to 'operator_startup_pair.json'. Inline mode rejected fail-closed.
